nonClaims: This pack does not provide a real postcode lookup.
This pack does not treat the 2020 operator addressing rule as proof of current operational applicability.
This pack does not download, store, or redistribute postcode mappings, municipality lists, classification entries, addresses, offices, contacts, properties, parcels, boundaries, or location records.
This pack does not assert a household, building, street, point, or address-to-postcode match.
This pack does not assert delivery-point or carrier deliverability coverage.
